answer:
usage: requivo answer [-h] [--workspace DIR] session answers

positional arguments:
  session          a session slug
  answers          the client's answers, as free text

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --workspace DIR  workspace root for sessions (default: cwd). Sessions live
                   in <workspace>/.requivo/sessions/. Accepted before or after
                   the command.
api:
usage: requivo api [-h] [--workspace DIR] <command> ...

positional arguments:
  <command>
    serve          serve the local HTTP API -- experimental; needs the [api]
                   extra

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --workspace DIR  workspace root for sessions (default: cwd). Sessions live
                   in <workspace>/.requivo/sessions/. Accepted before or after
                   the command.
artifact:
usage: requivo artifact [-h] [--workspace DIR] <action> ...

positional arguments:
  <action>
    save           save an artifact against a session
    list           list a session's artifacts + freshness
    show           print a saved artifact's content

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --workspace DIR  workspace root for sessions (default: cwd). Sessions live
                   in <workspace>/.requivo/sessions/. Accepted before or after
                   the command.

context:
usage: requivo context [-h] [--list] [--context CARDS] [--session SESSION]
                       [--workspace DIR]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --list                list available card stems instead of content
  --context, --cards CARDS
                        comma-separated subset to print (default: all). Alias:
                        --cards.
  --session SESSION     print exactly the cards this session was created with
  --workspace DIR       workspace root for sessions (default: cwd). Sessions
                        live in <workspace>/.requivo/sessions/. Accepted
                        before or after the command.

demo:
usage: requivo demo [-h] [--workspace DIR]

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --workspace DIR  workspace root for sessions (default: cwd). Sessions live
                   in <workspace>/.requivo/sessions/. Accepted before or after

discover:
usage: requivo discover [-h] [--once] [--context CARDS] [--workspace DIR]
                        request

positional arguments:
  request               the client request, a path to a file containing it, or
                        '-' to read it from stdin

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --once                single pass (status + questions), no interactive loop
  --context, --cards CARDS
                        comma-separated context cards to load instead of all
                        (e.g. b2b-platform,financial-reporting); sharpens
                        discovery by dropping irrelevant cards. Applies to
                        this discovery only. Alias: --cards.
  --workspace DIR       workspace root for sessions (default: cwd). Sessions
                        live in <workspace>/.requivo/sessions/. Accepted
                        before or after the command.
docs:
usage: requivo docs [-h] [--all] [--workspace DIR] [[slug] [type ...] ...]

positional arguments:
  [slug] [type ...]  an optional session slug, then document types to
                     generate; omit the types to see the menu (omit the slug
                     too for the workspace's default session)

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --all              generate every document, skipping the menu
  --workspace DIR    workspace root for sessions (default: cwd). Sessions live
                     in <workspace>/.requivo/sessions/. Accepted before or
                     after the command.

run:
usage: requivo run [-h] [--once] [--context CARDS] [--workspace DIR] [request]

positional arguments:
  request               the client request, a path to a file containing it,
                        '-' to read one from stdin, an existing session's slug
                        to resume, or omit to resume the workspace's default
                        session

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --once                single pass when starting a new discovery, no
                        interactive loop (refused when resuming an existing
                        session)
  --context, --cards CARDS
                        comma-separated context cards for a new discovery
                        (refused when resuming, which reuses the session's own
                        cards). Alias: --cards.
  --workspace DIR       workspace root for sessions (default: cwd). Sessions
                        live in <workspace>/.requivo/sessions/. Accepted
                        before or after the command.

usage: requivo schema [-h] [--framework] [--workspace DIR]

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --framework      also print the human framework spec
  --workspace DIR  workspace root for sessions (default: cwd). Sessions live
                   in <workspace>/.requivo/sessions/. Accepted before or after
                   the command.
session:
usage: requivo session [-h] [--workspace DIR] <action> ...

positional arguments:
  <action>
    init           create a session from a request (no LLM)
    list           list canonical sessions
    show           show a session's metadata + artifacts
    migrate        migrate ALL legacy out/ sessions into .requivo/sessions/
    export         export a session as a .zip archive
    verify         check that a session's files agree with each other
    restore        copy a readable revision over model.json — the recovery
                   path for a torn or inconsistent session (#210)
    rescope        re-scope an existing session's context cards
    import         import a session archive into the workspace
    delete         irreversibly remove a session -- `session export` first is
                   the undo story; there is no trash

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --workspace DIR  workspace root for sessions (default: cwd). Sessions live
                   in <workspace>/.requivo/sessions/. Accepted before or after
                   the command.

options:

web:
usage: requivo web [-h] [--host HOST] [--port PORT] [--workspace DIR]
                   [--no-open] [--reload]

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --host HOST      bind address (default: 127.0.0.1, localhost only)
  --port PORT      port (default: 8765)
  --workspace DIR  workspace root for sessions (default: cwd). Sessions live
                   in <workspace>/.requivo/sessions/. Accepted before or after
                   the command.
  --no-open        do not open a browser automatically
  --reload         auto-reload on code changes (development)
